image.alt: An excavation trench with finds still in position: stone tools, animal bones and a dark ash-filled hearth exposed in the trench floor, each marked with a small numbered tag.

options.text: What they ate, and how they built.
Only what they ate. Bones and seeds survive, but buildings leave no trace.
What they ate, how they built, and who their ruler was.
All four. A careful enough dig finds everything.
